Around [[3642 BBY]], [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] was sent to '''hunt''' for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Xerender]], a target of Baras' [[Plan Zero|plan]] to wipe out the strongest leaders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with the initiation of the [[Galactic War|new conflict]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] joined forces with the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] exile [[Broonmark]] and eliminated the Jedi and his force of [[Talz Commandos]].
